name: player_build_support_points_from_model
description: Player::BuildSupportPointsFromModel copies support00..support03 Object3D positions into modal support probe points and hides the source nodes.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Player bootstrap/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4220f0 validates fastcall ECX=saveState and EDX=modelNode, saveState->primaryModalState->masterModalData access, a four-iteration loop naming support%02d with sprintf, zClass_Class::FindSubNodeByName lookup, early return 0 on the first missing support node, Object3D position copy into probePoints[15..18], gwNodeSetActive(node, 0), and return 1 after all four nodes are processed.

The native smoke verifies support00..support03 lookup, position copies to PlayerMasterModalData::probePoints[15..18], active-flag clearing on all found support nodes, and the missing-node early-return behavior without overwriting the unvisited support slot.
